the diffusion of ICT is not a simple process of homogenization, but that it follows the logic of the spatial organization of the French territory, and the economic logic of the operators.

the digital divide in France is not only a social divide but also a spatial divide.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the organization of ICT is based on a spatial logic that combines the economic logic of profitability and the principle of territorial equality.
the diffusion of ICT has a spatial dimension.
, while the digital divide is not a spatial phenomenon, it is nevertheless a spatially structured phenomenon.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the organization of ICT in France is the result of the combination of three logics: a spatial logic that is linked to territorial structures and the distribution of activities, an economic logic that takes into account the profitability of the network operators, and a political logic that aims to ensure territorial equity.
the diffusion of ICT depends on the organization of space, and on the spatial position and hierarchy of territories.
the diffusion of ICT is not only determined by the economic logic of the market.
